gloss: being under the influence of alcohol; having alcohol in one's system

definitions.gloss: being under the influence of alcohol (legal/traffic term); having a detectable level of alcohol
definitions.explanation: The state of having a measurable amount of alcohol in one's body, used as a legal and traffic term in Japan. Distinct from full intoxication — it refers to any detectable alcohol level above the legal threshold.

examples.japanese: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}は{法律|ほうりつ}で{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Driving under the influence of alcohol is prohibited by law.

examples.japanese: {酒気帯|しゅきお}びの{状態|じょうたい}で{自転車|じてんしゃ}に{乗|の}るのも{違反|いはん}だ。
examples.english: Riding a bicycle while under the influence of alcohol is also a violation.

examples.japanese: {検問|けんもん}で{酒気帯|しゅきお}びが{発覚|はっかく}し、{免許|めんきょ}{停止|ていし}になった。
examples.english: Alcohol was detected at a checkpoint, and his license was suspended.

notes:
Composed of {酒気|しゅき} (the smell/presence of alcohol) and {帯|お}び (wearing, having on one's person). A legal and traffic-related term describing the state of having a detectable amount of alcohol in one's body. In Japanese traffic law, this is distinguished from {酔|よ}っ{払|ぱら}い{運転|うんてん} (drunk driving), which implies a higher level of intoxication.

USAGE:
Almost always appears in compound form:
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}: driving under the influence (DUI)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}: driving under the influence
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}びの{状態|じょうたい}: state of having alcohol in one's system
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{検査|けんさ}: alcohol breath test

LEGAL NOTE:
Japanese law distinguishes between {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん} (driving with alcohol detected, BAC 0.15mg/L or more) and {酒酔|しゅよ}い{運転|うんてん} (driving while intoxicated, based on impaired ability). The penalties for {酒酔|しゅよ}い{運転|うんてん} are more severe.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲酒|いんしゅ}{運転|うんてん}: drunk driving — a general term covering any alcohol-impaired driving
- {酒酔|しゅよ}い{運転|うんてん}: driving while intoxicated — more severe legal category
- {酔|よ}っ{払|ぱら}い: drunkard, drunk person — colloquial, not a legal term
